feasibility_negotiation_description: The feasibility assessment for the station-level energy saving task is complete: the current guaranteed throughput target cannot satisfy the power-outage duration requirement; see the infeasibility details and proposal.

infeasibility_details_and_proposal.name: Basis
infeasibility_details_and_proposal.value: The original request asks stations "Station 1" and "Station 2" to guarantee {00:00~06:00,2Mbps} and {06:00~18:00,10Mbps}, while the sites carry an existing constraint of at least 18 hours of power autonomy during an outage. With the current guaranteed rate the power consumption in that period cannot meet the outage-duration requirement; the conclusion is based on the sites' battery capacity and historical power curves.

infeasibility_details_and_proposal.name: Proposal
infeasibility_details_and_proposal.value: Lower the guaranteed throughput target for 06:00~18:00 from 10Mbps to 2Mbps, which extends the supportable outage duration to the required 18 hours. If lowering the rate is not acceptable, shorten the required outage duration instead. One of the two must be adjusted; no third option satisfies both original requirements.
